Class JdbcTransactionManager

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.transaction.support.AbstractPlatformTransactionManager
org.springframework.jdbc.datasource.DataSourceTransactionManager
org.springframework.jdbc.support.JdbcTransactionManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, InitializingBean, ConfigurableTransactionManager, PlatformTransactionManager, ResourceTransactionManager, TransactionManager
public class JdbcTransactionManager extends DataSourceTransactionManager
JdbcAccessor-aligned subclass of the plain DataSourceTransactionManager, adding common JDBC exception translation for the commit and rollback step. Typically used in combination with JdbcTemplate which applies the same SQLExceptionTranslator infrastructure by default.

异常翻译对于可序列化事务中的提交步骤特别相关（例如在 Postgres 上），因为并发失败可能在提交时晚些时候发生。这允许向调用者抛出 ConcurrencyFailureException，而不是 TransactionSystemException。

类似于 `HibernateTransactionManager` 和 `JpaTransactionManager`，此事务管理器可能会从 `AbstractPlatformTransactionManager.commit(TransactionStatus)` 抛出 `DataAccessException`，也可能从 `AbstractPlatformTransactionManager.rollback(TransactionStatus)` 抛出。调用代码应准备好在 `TransactionException` 旁边处理此类异常，因为这是合理的，因为 `TransactionSynchronization` 实现也可能在其 `flush` 和 `beforeCommit` 阶段抛出此类异常。

Since:
5.3
Author:
Juergen Hoeller，Sebastien Deleuze

    • setExceptionTranslator

      public void setExceptionTranslator(SQLExceptionTranslator exceptionTranslator)
      Set the exception translator for this transaction manager.

      默认情况下，如果用户在类路径根目录中找到了 `sql-error-codes.xml` 文件，则使用 `SQLErrorCodeSQLExceptionTranslator`；否则，自 6.0 版本起，`SQLExceptionSubclassTranslator` 作为默认转换器。

      See Also:
      • SQLErrorCodeSQLExceptionTranslator
      • SQLExceptionSubclassTranslator
      • JdbcAccessor.setExceptionTranslator(SQLExceptionTranslator)

    • setLazyInit

      public void setLazyInit(boolean lazyInit)
      Set whether to lazily initialize the SQLExceptionTranslator for this transaction manager, on first encounter of an SQLException. Default is "true"; can be switched to "false" for initialization on startup.

      早期初始化仅在调用afterPropertiesSet()时生效。

      See Also:
